_comment: Run template for synthetic-chw-plant-staging (generated by CAMBER, no real building): a chilled-water plant's chiller staging and condenser-water reset, at the trend's own 15-minute resolution. chiller_staging counts starts per day from the chiller power (warn at 6, fault at 12) and the share of running samples below 40 % of the chiller's observed peak load (warn at 25 %, fault at 50 %); condenser_water_reset regresses the tower's leaving water on the measured wet-bulb over operating samples (a slope under 0.3 F/F is a flat setpoint, a warn). Measured: PLANT__well_staged is ok on both; PLANT__short_cycling and PLANT__left_on fault on chiller_staging; PLANT__fixed_cw warns on condenser_water_reset; PLANT__high_floor passes it with a slope of 0.33.
